name: MarginEdge
oneLiner: Restaurant back-office platform that turns invoices and POS data into daily food cost, inventory and P&L numbers, with invoice processing, bill pay, ordering and recipe costing in one subscription.
bestFor: Independent restaurants and small-to-mid restaurant groups that want to cut manual invoice entry and see food cost in near real time rather than at month-end.

customers.name: The Tavern at Ivy City Smokehouse

updates.text: MarginEdge marked 10 years in business and 10,000 restaurant customers.
Raised $80 million (Series D equity plus debt) co-led by Schooner Capital and Ten Coves Capital, to build more AI products on the restaurant purchasing data it processes.

features: Invoice capture from photos, email or EDI, processed automatically
Daily food and beverage cost from POS sales plus invoice data
Bill pay included in the subscription
Inventory counts and recipe and menu-item costing
Price-change alerts on items you buy
Budgeting and P&L views, with accounting system sync (e.g. QuickBooks)
Integrations with dozens of POS systems

pricing.text: Published flat price per location per month with unlimited invoices and bill pay. MarginEdge's pricing page has shown $330 per location per month; 2026 third-party trackers report $350, plus $150 for the Freepour bar-inventory add-on. Confirm the current figure on marginedge.com/pricing before publishing.
